name: Suffix Master – Smart Title, Price & Content Branding
author: Al Imran Akash

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site’s branding with intelligent suffix management!

Suffix Master is the ultimate WordPress plugin for adding consistent, professional suffixes to your content. Whether you’re running a blog, business website, or WooCommerce store, this plugin gives you complete control over how your content appears to visitors and search engines.

🚀 Key Features

Content-Type Specific Control
* Global Title Suffix – Fallback for all content
* Post Title Suffix – Specific to blog posts only
* Page Title Suffix – Dedicated page title suffixes
* WooCommerce Product Titles – Professional product branding
* Price Suffixes – Add tax info, disclaimers, or promotional text
* Content Footer Suffixes – Consistent content endings
* Smart Slug Suffixes – SEO-friendly URL modifications

Advanced WooCommerce Integration
* Product title suffixes across all WooCommerce contexts
* Price suffix display on shop pages, single products, and cart
* Product-specific slug suffixes for better SEO
* Individual product override capabilities
* Compatible with all WooCommerce themes and extensions

Per-Item Override System
* Custom metaboxes on all edit screens
* Override global settings for specific posts, pages, or products
* Granular control when you need it
* Maintains global consistency while allowing exceptions

Dynamic Placeholders
* {year} – Automatically inserts current year
* {site_name} – Uses your WordPress site name
* Extensible system for future placeholder additions
* Perfect for copyright notices and time-sensitive content

User Experience Features
* Live Preview – See changes in real-time as you type
* Reset Functionality – Clear all settings with one click
* System Reports – Built-in troubleshooting information
* Security First – Comprehensive input validation and sanitization

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce Stores – Professional product branding and pricing display
  • Business Websites – Consistent corporate messaging
  • Blogs & News Sites – Automated copyright and branding
  • SEO Optimization – Enhanced URL structure and content consistency
  • Multi-site Networks – Centralized branding control

💡 Use Cases

E-commerce Branding
* Add “- Premium Quality” to all product titles
* Include “(Free Shipping)” in price displays
* Append “© 2024 YourStore” to product descriptions

SEO Enhancement
* Add year-based suffixes to blog post titles
* Include location-based suffixes for local SEO
* Create consistent URL patterns with slug suffixes

Professional Branding
* Append company taglines to page titles
* Add copyright notices to all content
* Include promotional messages in product pricing

🔧 Technical Features

  • Framework Architecture – Built on robust plugin framework
  • Performance Optimized – Minimal impact on site speed
  • Translation Ready – Full internationalization support
  • Developer Friendly – Extensive hooks and filters
  • Security Hardened – Follows WordPress security best practices

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit our website or contact us at hello@worzen.com.

Privacy Policy

Suffix Master does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All settings are stored locally in your WordPress database.

Credits

Developed by Worzen – Specialists in WordPress plugin development and digital solutions.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Suffix Master”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Go to Suffix Master in your admin menu to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/suffix-master/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  4. Configure settings at Suffix Master in your admin menu

Quick Setup

  1. Global Settings: Configure default suffixes in Global Suffix Settings
  2. WooCommerce: Set up product and price suffixes in WooCommerce Settings
  3. Per-Item: Override settings using metaboxes on individual posts/pages/products
  4. Preview: Enable live preview to see changes in real-time
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Suffix Master has comprehensive WooCommerce integration including product titles, prices, and slugs. It works with all WooCommerce themes and extensions.

Can I override global settings for specific items?

Absolutely! Every post, page, and WooCommerce product has a “Suffix Master Settings” metabox where you can set custom suffixes that override global settings.

What placeholders are available?

Currently supported: {year} (current year) and {site_name} (WordPress site name). More placeholders will be added in future updates.

Will this affect my SEO?

When used properly, Suffix Master can enhance your SEO by creating consistent, keyword-rich titles and URLs. The slug suffix feature is particularly useful for SEO optimization.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, Suffix Master is compatible with all major caching plugins including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and WP Super Cache.

Can I use HTML in content suffixes?

Yes, the content footer suffix field supports HTML, allowing you to add formatted text, links, and styling to your content endings.

Does it work with custom post types?

Currently, Suffix Master supports posts, pages, and WooCommerce products. Support for custom post types is planned for future releases.

How do I reset all settings?

Use the “Reset All Settings” button in the Tools & Actions tab. This will clear all configured suffixes and restore defaults.
